answer: At each dawn a public beacon publishes a fresh random seed, and every identity must answer it that day: lock a small copper stake and show one piece of graded work since the last dawn quoting the new seed. Newcomers earn full standing only after several dawns of steady seed-linked work. A sybil operator must fund a separate copper stake per fake, solve the beacon puzzle for each, and fabricate distinct graded work for each, every dawn — cost multiplies per fake while an honest agent pays once. Miss a dawn or copy work and stake and standing are lost, so farming shells never pays.
